references.text: The description of the gold altar for incense and its placement before the ark of the testimony, which gives the original instruction for what is carried out in Exodus 40:5.
The instruction to make the curtain for the entrance to the tabernacle, mentioned in the last part of the verse.
Bezalel makes the altar of incense from gold, which is now to be placed before the ark of the testimony.
The ark of the testimony is mentioned here along with the mercy seat, before which the golden altar is to be placed.
Specific instruction to place the altar in front of the curtain that is at the ark of the testimony.
The Letter to the Hebrews refers to the gold altar for incense in connection with the holy place of the tabernacle.
Revelation shows a golden altar before the throne where incense is offered together with the prayers of the saints.
The function of the curtain as a divider between the Holy Place and the Most Holy Place in 26:33 explains the significance of the arrangement in 40:5.
The confirmation of the mercy seat's location in the Most Holy Place defines the reference point for where the altar of incense is to be set.
The ritual with blood on the altar of incense in 6:7 explains the theological function of the object placed in 40:5.
